headline: Birr weakens further as NBE’s $140m forex auction draws $160.76m in bids
summary: The birr depreciated as commercial banks faced strong demand for foreign currency. In the National Bank of Ethiopia's 33rd auction, bids of $160.76 million exceeded the $140 million supply.
why: The National Bank of Ethiopia's forex auctions set the pace for the birr's official depreciation. Currency weakness raises import costs and affects foreign investors and businesses.

impacts.name: Ethiopian birr
impacts.why: Excess demand at the central bank's forex auction led to further depreciation of the birr against the dollar.
